notes.week_structure: Every week has 3 parts: (1) the main task, (2) a Practice Lab in the app, (3) that week's Office Life day in the app (Week 1 = Day 1 ... Week 4 = Day 4).
notes.task_types: In-app = done inside SabiRole (Practice Lab or Office Life) and marked automatically. Out-app = done with outside tools; the intern submits text or a link in the submission box.
notes.pacing: Cohort interns follow the weekly calendar. Self-paced interns unlock the next week (and the next Office Life day) as soon as they finish the current one, at any speed.
